full_judgment:
2. The relevant fact giving rise to this Rule in short is that the predecessor of the petitioners as plaintiff instituted a suit praying for a decree declaring that the suit land is a public path way and recording the same in B.S plot No. 3535 under the B.S. khatian No. 860 in the name of the defendant No. 1 by amalgamating the same with the land of R.S. plot No. 2399 corresponding to P.S. plot No. 2820 in the name  of Rangam Cinema is erroneous and void stating that the suit land measuring an area of .080 acre according to the R.S. Record is a continuous public pathway. In R.S. khatian No. 904 it was recorded in the name of the Chittagong Municipality and the column of comment of the khatian was noted as the public pathway in R.S. plot No. 2435 and also in the P.S. khatian No. 332 it was recorded in the name of the Education Department for the province of the then East Pakistan and the comment column was recorded as the pathway for the use of neighbouring plot owners in. P.S. plot No. 2813. The plaintiffs have been using the same as their pathway since their purchase of land in the contiguous north of the said pathway in R.S. plots Nos. 2387/2389 and 2390 corresponding to P.S. plot No. 3528 on 30.01.1964 vide registered deed No. 888 and prior to their purchase, their predecessor have used the suit land as their pathway. The suit land is a public pathway for more than one hundred years and other people are also using the same as their pathway other than the plaintiffs. In their said purchase deed No. 888 dated 30.01.1964 the suit land i.e. R.S plot Nos. 2435 and 2392 have also been mentioned as the road and public pathway and the plaintiffs have got their easement right over the suit land. There is the dwelling house of the plaintiffs in their aforementioned purchased land in R.S. plot No. 2389 corresponding to P.S. plot No. 3528 contiguous north of the suit land and while they were commonly using the same as the public pathway with the public. The B.S survey has taken place and the pathway has been wrongly amalgamated with the land of the principal defendant in P.S. plot No. 2820 corresponding to R.S. plot No. 2391 and recorded the same in B.S. plot No. 3535 under BS. khatian No. 860 in the name of the principal defendant beyond the knowledge of the plaintiffs and identified it to be the "Rangam Cinema Flail" omitting the land of R.S. plot No. 2391 corresponding to P.S. plot No. 2820 i. e, the land of the pathway. The plaintiffs for the first time came to team of the said wrong recording of the B.S. khatian in respect of the pathway at a time on 20.6.1998 while they were preparing a comparative map of the public pathway. The suit land is their only pathway and approach Road and they have their continuous easement rights over the suit land which has been clouded by the wrong preparation of the B.S. khatian No. 860. The plaintiffs have no other pathway except the one in question and have no other claim over the suit land except their acquired easement rights, hence the suit. 

 3. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint contending inter-alia that there is no public pathway as alleged in existence and obtained settlement from the Government. The R.S. khatian No. 959/5 stands recorded in its name and though in P.S plot No. 2813 and in P.S. Map an area of .0556 sataks was recorded as the pathway but it was not in existence. In R.S plot No. 2391 corresponding to P.S. plot No. 2820 and B.S. plot No. 3535 there is the pathway exclusively for the use of the members of the defendant and viewers of cinema of the said Rangam Cinema Hall and allowed the plaintiffs to use it in the western part and as such it has rightly been amalgamated and deleted with the B.S. plot No. 3535 during B.S operation with the knowledge of the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs have their alternative pathway and they are using the same from the time of their predecessors. 

 7. Mr. Md. Abdus Salam Mamun, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners who has placed before this court the revisional application, pleadings, evidence, judgment and decree of the courts below and submits that the trial court decreed the suit holding that there is a public pathway in R.S. and P.S. khatian and respective Maps. He submits that the R.S. and P.S. khatian were published after the deed dated 11.10.1915 area of land 40 decimals. He next submits that the defendant did not raise any objection in any forum about the existence of public pathway till today. He further submits that the lease deed itself the road has been mentioned in the schedule which is south to the plaintiff and north to the defendant's club. He further submits that the appellate court erroneously held that there is no road after mutation khatian but the mutation khatian No. 959/5 shows that there was a road in plot No. 2391/2634 (Exhibit Ga) area of road shown 3.50 decimals and (exhibit gha) plot No.2436/2642 nature of land unused land, area 3.70 decimals. He submits that the trial court has considered the advocate commissioner report (exhibit- II) who was examined as P.W. 4 who has categorically stated about the existence of the said road. He lastly submits that the appellate court being last and final court of fact failed to controvert the finding of the trial court and as such committed illegality in allowing the appeal and set aside the judgment of the trial court and as such the impugned judgment and decree is erroneous and liable to be set aside. 

 19. The appellate court without considering the above legal aspect of the case had abruptly reversed by taking into consideration exhibit Ga, Gha and A(3) which are mutation khatian has got no presumptive value since has not been supported by any deed of title on records and as such impugned judgment and decree passed by the appellate court is not sustainable in law.
